serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie.face.normal
You: Hi Annalie!
Annalie: Hello! I got some new clothes you might be interested in~
You: Maybe later. 
#Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.smile
Annalie: Usually when someone comes to a shop with clothing, they want to buy some clothes, y’know?
You: Don’t be so cold…
#Annalie.face.pervyGrin
Annalie: Oh, come on. I was joking! Didn’t you notice the characteristic silly face I make?
Annalie: Just say why did you come here for. As long as there are no clients around, I’m ready for anything~
#Annalie.Eyes.normal+Annalie.Mouth.sad
You: I wanted to ask you for advice.
Annalie: …
#Annalie.Eyes.closed+Annalie.Mouth.surprised
Annalie: Eh~ That’s it?
Annalie: Just say whatever is on your heart and I will do my best.
#Annalie.Eyes.normal+Annalie.Mouth.sad
You: Thanks…
She said that she would help, but judging by her face and tone of voice, she was hoping for me to say something else…
#Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.sad
You: So, there’s that girl.
#Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.surprised
Annalie: Really? A love advice?
Annalie: Well, {f_botName} is your girlfriend after all. What about her?
#Annalie.face.shocked
You: I’m not asking about {f_botName}...
#Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.smile
Annalie: You have no shame, do you?
You: It’s not like that!
#Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.normal
Annalie: Excuse me sir, if you are not going to buy anything, please leave. You are bothering other clients!
You: There’s no one besides us here!
#Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.sad
You: There’s a cashier in a local supermarket that I think has similar hobbies to {f_botName}.
#Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.surprised
Annalie: Hobbies?{{wi}} Why did you say it that way?
#Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.smile
Annalie: Is that some slang for fetishes? Are you looking for someone for a threesome? How come you never asked me to join up and instead you are trying to hit on some cashier?{{wi}} Not like I would be interested in anything like that anyway. I would refuse outright! 
You: Stop teasing…
#Annalie.Eyes.pervy+Annalie.Mouth.normal
Annalie: Teasing? I wonder about that…
You: A-Anyway! It has nothing to do with threesomes!
You: By hobbies I meant just that! I think they have a lot in common…
#Annalie.face.normal
Annalie: So, what’s the problem then? 
You: I wanted to ask you for advice on how to approach her about becoming friends with {f_botName}.
Annalie: I’m confused. They are both grown ups, right? Why should you approach some girl about becoming friends with your girlfriend?
You: Well, it’s a little more complicated than that…
Annalie: Whatever the circumstances may be, letting them talk it out themselves would be something I would do.
Now that I think about it, maybe she’s right?
You: Alright, I think I got closer to an answer. Thanks Annalie!
Annalie: No problem.
Annalie: Are you ready to see these new clothes now? 
You: Yes…
